title: The Long Silence
protagonist: ensemble (no single lead; the contact-generation cast)
logline: A species clever enough to split the atom but foolish enough to broadcast its address learns, too late, the one law of a universe full of listeners: the wise stay silent, and the loud do not last.
blueprint: Liu Cixin Remembrance of Earth's Past engine: Dark Forest as moral physics; the broadcast-folly thesis; droplet-grade set-pieces; native-English prose, no translation stiffness; original cast and scenes
market: literary hard SF / first-contact / cosmic-scale tragedy: craft exercise, not for commercial release
lineage: Liu Cixin, The Three-Body Problem / The Dark Forest / Death's End (2008-2010) — Remembrance of Earth's Past
